hero.title: Meet the team behind our translators

intro.title: Select professional translators for quality and affordability
intro.lead: Every project goes to a specialist who translates into their native language, with one project manager keeping it on track.

cards.title: Remote teams across the UK
cards.html: With teams working remotely across London, Manchester, Birmingham, Leeds and Glasgow (no costly offices, company cars or heavy business rates to pay), we reduce our costs and share that price advantage with our customers, offering them affordable translation services.

cards.title: Professional translators only
cards.html: BeTranslated exclusively consists of professional translators serving clients across the UK and all over Europe.

cards.title: One project manager
cards.html: One of BeTranslated's project managers will be your point of contact and will oversee every aspect of your project.

roster.title: Meet the BeTranslated team
roster.lead: The people who look after your project from request to delivery, backed by our network of native specialist translators.

steps.title: What happens next
items: Request a quote
One of our regional managers will receive your request for a translation quote.
Reply
A member of BeTranslated will respond to you within a maximum of 8 working hours.
Assessing your project
We match your project to the translator who best meets your needs according to the details of your request.
Delivery
You will receive the translated files within the agreed deadline.
Follow-up and invoicing
Once you are satisfied with your translation, we will send you your invoice.

interp.title: Interpreters for meetings and events
interp.html: Need an interpreter as well as a translator? Our remote interpreting services cover business meetings and virtual events on Zoom, Teams and Google Meet.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
items: How do you choose translators for my project?
We match your project to a translator with experience in your subject area.
Your language pair, the document type and the audience all guide the choice.
Tell us about your field and we find the right person.
Do your translators work into their native language?
Yes. We work with professional translators who translate into their native language.
That keeps the finished text natural and accurate for your readers.
Mention any regional variety you need and we match it.
Can I work with the same translator again?
Yes. You can ask us to keep the same translator for future projects.
That helps your terminology and tone stay consistent.
We keep your glossary and preferences on file for the next job.
How do you keep my documents confidential?
We share your files only with the translators working on them.
You can ask us to sign a confidentiality agreement before you send anything.
Tell us about any extra security rules and we follow them.
Can I get a quote before I commit?
Yes. Send us your files, the languages and your deadline.
We review them and reply with a free, no-obligation quote.
You decide whether to go ahead after you see it.

story.title: Our story
paras: BeTranslated was born in 2002 in Liège, Belgium. More than two decades later, we translate for businesses and individuals across more than 50 language combinations, with offices in Belgium, Spain, France, Germany and the US, and project teams working remotely across the UK.
We are a translation agency built by translators. Every one of our project managers is, or has been, a translator, so they understand the challenges behind each brief.

Each translator works only into their native language and specialises in a sector such as legal, financial, technical, medical or marketing. Every project goes through the same quality chain: analysis of the brief, assignment to a native specialist, translation with memories and glossaries, and review by a second independent linguist.
